description: Land Title Settlement Department - Midellawala, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510233
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for specific land parcels (Nos. 22 and 34) in Gampaha District.
